OR-ed (punctuation is FTS5 syntax)

db::vector_search — b2-core/src/db.rs:
full in-process scan of embeddings,
embed::l2_sq per chunk vector,
nearest first, keep pool_size

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
best_cos = 1 − d²/2 of the dense head
(cosine_of_distance; exact for unit vectors)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
provenance_of: per chunk id, record
bm25_rank / vector_rank / distance —
None where a list never ranked it

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
rrf_fuse, RRF_K = 60:
score = Σ 1 / (60 + rank + 1) over both lists;
exact ties → rank in the dense list
(passed last on purpose), then chunk id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
resolve_hits: walk the fused order,
skip a chunk whose note vanished mid-query
(C1 torn read — the pool backfills it),
keep the first hit-pool hits

ranked chunk Hits, pool-wide,
